args.title: Persist export format selection in ExportButton
args.body:
File: src/components/ExportButton.tsx

Change the ExportButton component to store the export format selection in localStorage and initialize its state from localStorage so that it remembers the user's last chosen export format across page loads.

label: feature
file: src/components/ExportButton.tsx
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

The export format selection in ExportButton.tsx should persist the user's last chosen format in localStorage to remember it across page loads, improving user experience by avoiding the need to reselect the format every time.
